name: Partners
insp: Luxe editorial portraiture: fashion-magazine people pages, Awwwards studio team galleries
desc: Ivory and deep blue editorial with a high-contrast Bodoni display. The team photo opens from a small card into a deep-blue field, then the partners glide past in a pinned horizontal portrait gallery at three parallax depths.
fx: Headline that sets itself letter by letter, then a team photo card that opens into a full-width deep-blue scene as you scroll
Pinned sideways portrait gallery with names, titles and credentials rising out of line masks
Team names that show a brand-colour monogram card following the pointer
Five promises that each fill the screen in turn, in alternating brand colours
Service rows with the matching photo following the pointer, and an award photo that zooms out from a close crop
Custom cursor, smooth scrolling on laptops and fine vector grain
